answer: Juniper behavior-fingerprint escrow bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and escrows a fingerprint of its juniper-grove work. At dawn the beacon samples one; a falcon auditor replays it against the dawn log. A copied fingerprint burns the bond; a falcon recheck next dawn catches rented prints, as only the live key reproduces it. First 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000, locking 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once.
